properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: DropDownLines
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of list lines displayed in the drop-down portion of a combo box. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: True if the object is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LargeChange
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount that the scroll box increments or decrements for a page scroll (when the user clicks in the scroll bar body region). Read/write Long.

properties.name: LinkedCell
properties.description: Returns or sets the worksheet range linked to the control's value. If you place a value in the cell, the control takes this value. Likewise, if you change the value of the control, that value is also placed in the cell. Read/write String.

properties.name: ListCount
properties.description: Returns the number of entries in a list box or combo box. Returns 0 (zero) if there are no entries in the list. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ListFillRange
properties.description: Returns or sets the worksheet range used to fill the specified list box. Setting this property destroys any existing list in the list box. Read/write String.

properties.name: ListIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the index number of the currently selected item in a list box or combo box. Read/write Long.

properties.name: LockedText
properties.description: True if the text in the specified object will be locked to prevent changes when the workbook is protected. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Max
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum value of a scroll bar or spinner range. The scroll bar or spinner won't take on values greater than this maximum value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Min
properties.description: Returns or sets the minimum value of a scroll bar or spinner range. The scroll bar or spinner won't take on values less than this minimum value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MultiSelect
properties.description: Returns or sets the selection mode of the specified list box. Can be one of the following constants: xlNone, xlSimple, or xlExtended. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PrintObject
properties.description: True if the object will be printed when the document is printed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SmallChange
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount that the scroll bar or spinner is incremented or decremented for a line scroll (when the user chooses an arrow). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the name of the specified control format.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to a list box or a combo box.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position of the new entry. If the list has fewer entries than the specified index, blank items from the end of the list are added to the specified position. If this argument is omitted, the item is appended to the existing list.

methods.name: RemoveAllItems
methods.description: Removes all entries from a Microsoft Excel list box or combo box.

methods.name: RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes one or more items from a list box or combo box.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the first item to be removed. Valid values are from 1 to the number of items in the list (returned by the ListCount property).

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of items to be removed, starting at item _Index_. If this argument is omitted, one item is removed. If _Index_ + _Count_ exceeds the number of items in the list, all items from _Index_ through the end of the list are removed without an error.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns or sets the text entries in the specified list box or combo box, as an array of strings, or returns or sets a single text entry. An error occurs if there are no entries in the list.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of a single text entry to be set or returned. If this argument is omitted, the entire list is returned or set as an array of strings.
